answer: Each agent must lock a bond to register; peers verify work at the violet checkpoint, and a falcon auditor randomly samples submissions each epoch. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: stake-weighted identity with a burn penalty. Falsely registered identities lose their bond, and repeat offenders are pushed off the ridge of trusted reputation. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, so mass sybil creation becomes economically prohibitive. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
